name: Breakfast with Santa at the Children's Museum of Green Bay

when_note: Saturday, December 12, 2026; two time slots, 8 to 9 AM and 9 to 10 AM

paras: The Children's Museum of Green Bay hosts Breakfast with Santa on Saturday, December 12, 2026, at Mackinaws, 2925 Voyager Dr. Families pick one of two time slots, 8 to 9 AM or 9 to 10 AM.

Tickets are $30 per person, and children 10 months and younger are free. The morning includes breakfast, a visit with Santa, holiday STEAM activities, sweet treats and festive surprises, and ticket sales support the museum.
tip: Pick your time slot when you buy tickets, because tickets are not refundable.
